title: GAMW: Generation-Aware Mel-Domain Watermarking for TTS Traceability
abstract: arXiv:2610.15082v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As text-to-speech (TTS) systems continue to advance, provenance tracking and security verification of synthesized speech have become increasingly important. Audio watermarking provides active provenance by embedding imperceptible, machine-recoverable information into speech. However, existing post-hoc methods typically modify the waveform after synthesis, leaving the watermark vulnerable to compound perturbations. To address this limitation, we propose GAMW, a watermark injection framework integrated into the TTS generation process. Before waveform synthesis, GAMW embeds a content-adaptive multi-bit watermark residual into the generated representation, and its decoding objective combines focal modulation with dynamic per-bit weighting. We train and evaluate GAMW separately on two TTS backbones. translated_title: GAMW：面向TTS可溯源性的生成感知梅尔域水印
translated_abstract: 随着文本转语音（TTS）系统的持续发展，合成语音的溯源追踪与安全验证变得日益重要。音频水印通过在语音中嵌入不可感知、可被机器恢复的信息，提供了主动式的溯源能力。然而，现有的后处理方法通常在合成之后对波形进行修改，使得水印容易受到复合扰动的影响。为解决这一局限，我们提出了GAMW，一个集成到TTS生成过程中的水印注入框架。在波形合成之前，GAMW将内容自适应的多比特水印残差嵌入到生成的表示中，其解码目标将焦点调制与动态逐比特加权相结合。我们在两个TTS骨干网络上分别对GAMW进行了训练与评估。在16比特载荷下，GAMW在单独扰动与复合扰动下的解码准确率分别比最强基线提升了9.2和23.5个百分点。
tldr: GAMW将内容自适应的多比特水印直接注入TTS生成过程而非事后修改波形，并通过焦点调制与动态逐比特加权的解码目标，在两个TTS骨干上显著提升水印解码准确率，实现合成语音的可溯源与安全验证。
en_tdlr: GAMW embeds content-adaptive multi-bit watermarks directly into the TTS generation process rather than modifying waveforms post-hoc, and leverages focal modulation with dynamic per-bit weighting to substantially improve decoding accuracy, enabling traceability of synthesized speech.
